episodes.title: Part 1: The Royal Whirlwind
episodes.break_rationale: Mili arrives at the rigid Sambalpur palace to treat King Shekhar, creating instant comic friction with the strict royal matriarch Nirmala Devi and catching Prince Vikram's attention.
episodes.recap_text: Quirky physiotherapist Dr. Mili Chakravarty is hired to rehabilitate the stubborn, wheelchair-bound King of Sambalpur, shaking up the austere royal household.
episodes.teaser_next: Mili's loud, colorful personality challenges Prince Vikram's disciplined royal decorum.

episodes.title: Part 2: Breaking the Palace Rules
episodes.break_rationale: Mili breaks the palace rules to help Shekhar smile again, while late-night conversations with Vikram ignite an undeniable mutual attraction.
episodes.recap_text: Mili slowly wins over the depressed King with warmth and games, while sharing humorous late-night encounters with the stoic Prince Vikram.
episodes.teaser_next: An unexpected desert kidnapping turns palace duty into romantic adventure.

episodes.title: Part 3: Desert Confessions
episodes.break_rationale: After escaping bungling kidnappers in the Rajasthani desert, Vikram and Mili share an intimate night, only for Vikram's royal engagement to pull them apart.
episodes.recap_text: Stranded in the desert together, Mili and Vikram let their guards down, but royal duty and societal expectations threaten to crush their bond.
episodes.teaser_next: The King takes his first steps as Vikram is forced to make an agonizing choice between duty and love.

episodes.title: Part 4: The Royal Heart
episodes.break_rationale: King Shekhar walks, and Prince Vikram publicly defies palace tradition to run after Mili in Delhi for a joyful, heartwarming royal reunion.
episodes.recap_text: Having healed the royal family from within, Mili departs heartbroken, prompting Vikram to finally stand up to royal rigidity and follow his heart.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the beloved romantic comedy miniseries cut of Khoobsurat.
